The '''cannon furnace''' powers the [[dwarf multicannon]]. It is the last part to be setup after the [[cannon barrels]]. Once setup, 30 [[steel cannonball]]s or [[granite cannonball]]s can be loaded for the dwarf multicannon to fire. It is purchased from [[Multicannon parts for sale]] for {{NoCoins|200625}} coins.
